sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8 is an abliterated and block-FP8 quantized version of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B, maintained by orcarouter. The model removes refusal mechanisms through orthogonalization of the safety direction from residual-writing matrices, then applies offline block-FP8 quantization (E4M3, 128×128 block size) matching the official Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 byte-for-byte.
